contract: Rewrite the prose of the section and keep the TOML block byte for byte. The prose keeps its own facts: the controller closes the dome by itself in bad weather; operators can close it by hand from the console at any time; on lost contact with the weather mast it leaves the dome where it is and raises a console alarm; it does not reopen the dome after the weather clears, the night crew does. Thresholds, the rain sensor, the grace period and the comment about short gusts appear only in the block and stay out of the prose. No reason for closing is added.
source_statements: The dome controller closes the dome on its own when the weather turns bad.
Operators can also close it by hand from the console at any time.
If the controller loses contact with the weather mast, it leaves the dome where it is and raises an alarm on the console.
It does not reopen the dome by itself after the weather clears; someone on the night crew has to do that.
legitimate_alternatives: Keep "bad weather" general without naming thresholds or sensors.
Drop the praise and the "huge relief" remark, or keep a plain version of it.
Reorder sentences or split the lost-contact paragraph.

examples.label: valid
examples.text:
## Dome closing

The dome controller closes the dome by itself when the weather turns bad, which takes a load off the night crew. Operators can also close it by hand from the console at any time.

```toml
[dome.autoclose]
wind_gust_kmh = 45
humidity_pct = 88
rain_sensor = true
grace_seconds = 90  # gusts shorter than this are ignored
```

If the controller loses contact with the weather mast, it leaves the dome where it is and raises an alarm on the console. It does not reopen the dome after the weather clears. Someone on the night crew has to do that.

examples.label: valid
examples.text:
## Dome closing

When the weather turns bad, the controller closes the dome on its own. The night crew can also close it manually from the console whenever they want.

```toml
[dome.autoclose]
wind_gust_kmh = 45
humidity_pct = 88
rain_sensor = true
grace_seconds = 90  # gusts shorter than this are ignored
```

Losing contact with the weather mast doesn't close the dome: the controller holds its current position and sounds an alarm on the console. Reopening after bad weather is always manual; the controller never reopens the dome on its own.
